description: Genset controller (HGM6110 auto start, HGM6120 AMF): mains and generator values, engine sensors, ECU data, alarms, status and remote commands
source: SmartGen, HGM6100N/HGM6100CAN Genset Controller Communication Protocol
notes: Modbus RTU over RS485, slave only. Address 1 to 254 (default 1); 2400 to 115200 baud (default 9600), 8 data bits, no parity by default, 1 stop bit. Up to 120 registers per read; allow more than 200 ms for the answer.
Status bits are coils read with function 01; remote commands are coils at the same addresses written with function 05 (0xFF00), each sent once. Values are holding registers read with 03.
Addresses are the 'Modbus Address' column of the manual (the PLC address less 1).
ECU values (J1939) are only on the HGM6100CAN with an ECU engine; on the HGM6100N those registers are reserved.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
